title: Greece Plans Crypto Capital Gains Tax: Report
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Greece Plans Crypto Capital Gains Tax: Report Greece is planning a law to tax crypto investors’ capital gains at a rate of 15%, according to reports. According to Reuters and local media, the country’s Finance Ministry has drafted a bill with the proposal. Greece currently has no legal framework for taxing crypto.
